name: Ambiguous Organization Build Lock
postCreateCommand: if [ -f .devcontainer/scripts/post-create.sh ]; then bash .devcontainer/scripts/post-create.sh; else set -eu; export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-get update; apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends bat direnv fd-find hyperfine jq make man-db procps ripgrep shellcheck tree xz-utils; machine="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; case "${machine}" in amd64) go_arch=amd64; go_sha=63d339f0da5ab53635a56f2490a7984dfe12dfcff22ad749f63edaf590168445; node_arch=x64; node_sha=fd8e59d5a511510f6a298afb548f18c7d2b1be404d8b4a27d94fbe49f56cb2d6; gh_arch=amd64; gh_sha=bb766f710eef8ede859c18578c72c327597cd4c8a85b06001b1f3843c6019386 ;; arm64) go_arch=arm64; go_sha=3450b45a3f9ee8568792736a5c5e70a1f2e9b36c35a8f74958c03e51d7d92bec; node_arch=arm64; node_sha=6ad1325edbdb5649c379b75a237147a666c95d4f9ae8d340fef2d1575d289ad2; gh_arch=arm64; gh_sha=7862c86c72f43df3a2d93ddde6f473285b4e2af61b494849846827e513ef6484 ;; *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${machine}" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-${go_arch}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/go.tar.gz; echo "${go_sha}  /tmp/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; rm -rf /usr/local/go; tar -xzf /tmp/go.tar.gz -C /usr/local; rm -f /tmp/go.tar.gz; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-${node_arch}.tar.xz" -o /tmp/node.tar.xz; echo "${node_sha}  /tmp/node.tar.xz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xJf /tmp/node.tar.xz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1; rm -f /tmp/node.tar.xz; curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.102.0/gh_2.102.0_linux_${gh_arch}.tar.gz" -o /tmp/gh.tar.gz; echo "${gh_sha}  /tmp/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -; tar -xzf /tmp/gh.tar.gz -C /tmp; install -m 0755 "/tmp/gh_2.102.0_linux_${gh_arch}/bin/gh" /usr/local/bin/gh; rm -rf /tmp/gh.tar.gz "/tmp/gh_2.102.0_linux_${gh_arch}"; ln -sf /usr/bin/batcat /usr/local/bin/bat; ln -sf /usr/bin/fdfind /usr/local/bin/fd; for tool in /usr/local/go/bin/go /go/bin/*; do if [ -x "${tool}" ]; then ln -sf "${tool}" "/usr/local/bin/$(basename "${tool}")"; fi; done; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; fi
